QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is set only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is defined, the compiler is GNU-compatible (GCC or Clang, not MSVC or old armcc), and the architecture is one of the four listed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is set automatically from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler/architecture conditions, which means it is derived. It does not describe it as a config entry.
